Verified elevated via test/phase2-verify.ps1 with a real watchdog pair: CONTROL case proves killing the holder alone lets the watchdog respawn it; the suspend-then-unlock path leaves the file free with no respawn; and no test process is left suspended afterwards. Resolved by designing the assets rather than vendoring third-party ones (operator direction: 'find something free or design things yourself'). assets/icons.css is a first-party 45-glyph set on a 24x24 grid with a 2px stroke, delivered as CSS mask images so glyphs paint in currentColor and every existing <i class='fa-solid fa-x'> keeps working with zero markup changes - no FontAwesome, no licence to carry, no attribution burden. Web fonts replaced with the OS stack (Segoe UI Variable / Segoe UI), which is native on both target OS versions. CSP now names NO external origin: default-src 'self' + connect-src 'none'. Verified: app boots with zero CSP violations and zero console errors, and the icon set was visually reviewed at multiple sizes (seven glyphs redrawn after the first pass read wrong - gears looked like a sun, cubes like a molecule, rocket like an insect).
